name: Juvederm Volbella
lead: Juvéderm Volbella (VYC-15L; Volbella XC with lidocaine) is a low-concentration cross-linked hyaluronic acid (HA) filler from Allergan, made with Vycross technology and used for fine lines and delicate areas, chiefly the lips and perioral region and the under-eye hollow (infraorbital) area. [1][2]

Randomized and open-label trials report improvement in lip fullness out to 12 months, and trials in infraorbital hollowing have been run in the US and China. [3][4][5] Reports of delayed reactions in the tear-trough area and lips have also been published. [6]

paras: The product is a 15 mg/mL HA gel formulated with Vycross technology; a postmarket lip study used the lidocaine version. [2] Laboratory comparisons of seven cross-linking technologies tested properties such as cohesivity and resistance to compression across HA gels. [7] A review discusses Voluma, Volift and Volbella together as a Vycross range suited to different depths and areas. [8]
Lip and perioral enhancement and infraorbital hollowing are the main studied uses. [3][4][5][9]

A retrospective study of 400 patients reported that a newly introduced filler in the tear-trough area and lips was associated with a higher rate of late reactions, with persistent and recurrent courses, than the 0.02% rate recorded for HA fillers generally. [6]

A 12-month multicenter open-label study of 60 subjects treated the perioral area and used a lip fullness responder endpoint. [3] A postmarket study of 62 subjects evaluated aesthetic impact in the lips. [2] Randomized, controlled studies followed lip and perioral enhancement for 12 months. [4][10][11] A repeat-treatment study examined retreatment safety. [12] An open-label study evaluated infraorbital skin depressions. [5]
Registered trials include lip comparisons with Restylane-L (n=285), a lip study with 225 participants and Chinese lip (n=176) and infraorbital (n=160) studies. [13][14][15][16]

card.summary: Allergan's fine HA filler for lips and under-eye hollows, backed by randomized trials, with reports of late reactions in the tear-trough area.
card.note: Delayed reactions reported in tear-trough and lip treatment.

quick.overview:
Volbella is a thin, low-concentration hyaluronic acid filler used for lip enhancement, perioral lines and under-eye hollows.

Trials of up to 12 months report improved lip fullness, and infraorbital studies have been run in the US and China.
quick.mechanism: A lightly cross-linked HA gel (Vycross) is placed superficially to add soft volume and smooth fine lines; it degrades over time.
quick.risks: Reported effects include swelling and bruising; one retrospective report described recurrent delayed reactions in the tear-trough area and lips. It is a prescription device given by licensed clinicians.
